checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Clear forest green with a matte finish and soft highlights.

must.item: Bottle retains exact silhouette, position, surface details
must.why: Shape and position match. The cap loop and bottom seam look slightly softened or altered, which is minor.

must.item: Wooden table, background and cast shadow unchanged
must.why: They look the same at a glance. The wood grain looks slightly smoother or softer.

must.item: No visible alterations outside bottle mask at matching resolution
must.why: I could only compare by eye. The image looks a bit softer and regenerated, which suggests small differences in texture, but I can't confirm a pixel diff.

must.item: No green spill, halo, crop or framing shift
must.why: No spill, halo or shift is visible.

faults.what: The whole image looks slightly softer and regenerated, with smoother wood grain and a softer cap detail. This suggests an AI redraw instead of a masked edit.

summary: The bottle is now a convincing matte forest green with the scene, shadow and framing preserved. The only issue is slight softening that suggests a full-image regeneration.
